title: The Online class on Monday
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：online　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 online 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the trader wrote of ① an online class on Monday in the list, and everybody in the market said at once that it was ② so online that nobody in the market would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the trader, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the online ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the online class on Monday that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for October 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too online to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the partner who had come to help; the online ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an online shop of the company, and said that no partner in his right mind would call it ⑥ as online as the shop of the company they had once had in the old market. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was online or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something online, and nothing besides. The partner from the next market called the whole plan ⑧ quite online; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the online ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, in the rain, she wrote of another online class on Monday in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less online than anybody had expected. ⑩ The online shop of the company that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the online ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 在线（前置定语 an online class on Monday：1989 年货商在货单里记下的那件在线的线上课）
B. adj. 在线／网上（两处加强说法：so online that … 与 no less online than …）
C. adj. 在线／网上（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 在线（表语 too online to do：母亲觉得它太在线，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 网上（前置定语 an online shop of the company：叔叔把整件事称作一桩网上的网店）
F. adj. 网上（同级比较 as online as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩公司的网店相比）
G. adj. 网上（后置定语 something online：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 网上（受程度副词修饰 quite online：那位伙计的评价）

items.q: the online class on Monday that
an online shop of the company
The online shop of the company that

answers.why: online 意为“在线”，1989 年货商在货单里记下的是“一件在线的线上课”，此处作前置定语 an online class on Monday。
online 意为“在线”，此处用 so online that 结构，说它在线到集市里没人敢靠近。
online 意为“在线”，货单上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的在线周一的线上课，等于最高级的说法。
online 意为“在线”，母亲认为这件东西“太在线了，谁也用不上”，too online to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
online 意为“网上”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩网上的网店”，此处作前置定语 an online shop of the company。
online 意为“网上”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩公司的网店一样网上”，同级比较用 as online as。
online 意为“网上”，货单上那半行字要的是“网上的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something online。
online 意为“网上”，邻集市来的那位伙计认为这套计划“相当网上”，quite 修饰原级 online。
online 意为“网上”，no less online than 表示“其网上不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之网上不亚于任何人的预料。
online 意为“网上”，母亲 2001 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的网上网店”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，货商在货单里记下了一件在线的线上课。（an online class on Monday）
它在线到集市里没有一个人敢靠近。（so online that …）
母亲觉得它太在线，谁也用不上。（too online to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩网上的网店。（an online shop of the company）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩公司的网店一样网上。（as online as …）
到了 1996 年，货单上只剩半行字：要的是一件网上的东西。（something online）
answers: In 1989 the trader wrote of an online class on Monday in the list.
It was so online that nobody in the market would go near it.
My mother thought it too online to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an online shop of the company.
He said nobody would call it as online as the shop of the company they had once had.
By 1996 the list asked for nothing but something online.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 online 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the trader wrote of an online class on Monday in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the online class on Monday that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too online to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an online shop of the company, and nobody argued with him.
The partner from the next market called the plan quite online, and everybody laughed.
The online ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
